mathematically_sound_transformation: Reuse exactly 004D4 source partition; select subset of complete parity equations, replace each chosen original full sign-mask block with an equivalent native XOR equation; restore all original clauses belonging to *unselected* XOR groups verbatim, preserving every residual source clause and all original semantics. The arbitrary threshold uses the same original clause coverage ratio and 004E2 gate, no new equations.

plan.resource_policy: No extra payer/Oracle/NAS/Rowan; 4 CPU VMs short-lived, max 20 concurrent, no auto-recursion or schedule

selection.scoring: same-worker paired original-CNF SAT verified completion; candidate full end-to-end wall only if both complete, otherwise CENSORED not a ratio; aggregate per family across variants; no global winner if all censored

verification.worker_identification: Unique GitHub job id and runner name; 24 jobs does not imply 24 concurrently running
